name: rumbo
description: Keep agreed work connected to its artifacts, evidence and human decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Keep work on its agreed course
interface.longDescription: Inspect the agreed goal and constraints, claim bounded tasks, register exact artifact revisions, run deterministic acceptance checks and request human decisions. The project board separates work claims, narrow check receipts, reviewer assertions and human acceptance. Rumbo does not grant authority, run arbitrary commands, or prove that every requirement is correct.
defaultPrompt: What evidence is missing before acceptance?
Which work became stale after the last change?

publication.release_notes: 0.3.8 local review candidate: adds optional question observations on local MCP stdio with engine 0.3.6. Existing clients keep full snapshots by default and unguarded questions are unchanged. Guarded stale questions append nothing; reread and reconsider. Mutations still support response_mode=receipt; tools/list schemas are larger even without opt-in. Receipts are incomplete operation-time observations with a full-state recovery call. No new roles. No deployment, live installation or human approval claimed. The local commitments helper bundles the record runtime of the Claude adapter in the same source tree, where a check can name older checks of its kind in replaces (since 0.3.12) or the user's decision that dropped its option in dropped_by (since 0.3.14).
